name: P3-0 offline probe (Anvil card p3-source-self-check)
frozen: 2026-10-02, before any 4B prompt dump was seen
labels_source: rnd/research/compass/rows.json (Compass in-kit taxonomy, and-qwen s42/s43); answers = full text from boar-eval/runs/night-2026-10-01/<run>.traces.jsonl
sentence_split: re.split(r'(?<=[.!?])\s+|\n+', answer) stripped, empty removed; labels S1..Sk in order
passages: system message of the s44 --dump-prompts row for the same itemId; an item is EXCLUDED (and reported) if the s44 trace's retrieval.kept titles differ from the labelled run's

check_turn.model: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 Q4_K_M (shared-models), node-llama-cpp, temp 0, maxTokens 12, thoughtTokens 0
check_turn.messages: dump system + dump user + assistant(labelled answer) + user(CHECK)
check_turn.CHECK: Check your answer against the numbered passages. Your sentences: {LIST} Reply with the labels of sentences that a passage contradicts or that contradict another of your sentences, or reply "none". Labels only.
check_turn.LIST: S<i> «first 6 words of sentence i…»  joined by spaces

parse: labels = set of S<number> tokens in the reply (case-insensitive); 'none' with no labels = empty set; anything else (no labels, no 'none') = parse failure

metrics.positive_hit: labels ∩ targets ≠ ∅ (detection; guard outcome reported separately)
metrics.negative_false_flag: labels ≠ ∅ (strict: any flag on a correct answer)
metrics.guard_report: for each item: flagged > half of sentences -> answer kept unchanged (reported, not a criterion)

criterion: PASS iff positive hits >= 3/7 AND negative false flags <= 2/20 AND parse failures <= 2/27. With exclusions: hits >= ceil(3/7*n_pos), false flags <= floor(2/20*n_neg), parse failures <= floor(2/27*n_all). Fail -> the 4B is not a usable self-checker; P-3 on the 4B closes (hand to Compass NLI line).
